Mc.bar_b_note: A's large readable cards and icon-led ingredients come close to Palworld's HUD hierarchy, but neither side uses teal/cyan interaction or controller-glyph prompts, and B's tiny truncated rows and grey text hints sink it.

Kh.bar_b_note: Every frame, including 'day clear', is a murky brown-green box with only a sliver of sky, no sun direction, haze or tall lit keep, so it reads as an unlit dungeon rather than a Valheim-lit Meadows stronghold.

My.bar_b_note: B's standing wolf matches the owner's Tanglevolt bar (dark fur, purple veins, white chest) but its faint mid/end float well above their shadows, while A's over-saturated blue glow drowns the fur and its faint end flips into an upended headstand.

Yx.bar_b_note: The old villager has a clear readable face, expressive eyes and a green-brown Meadows palette that would sit beside Palworld NPCs; only the stiff full-body stance and oversized head hold it back.

Oy.bar_b_note: Dense grass, a winding path and a bright sky get the palette close, but the uniform grass carpet, evenly scattered same-size saplings and flat haze-free distance (plus A's shard canopy) keep it short of Palworld density and Valheim atmosphere.

Qn.bar_b_note: Same grove as Oy: B's rounded leafy crown helps, but the even sapling scatter, wall-to-wall grass, small wild creatures and no fog, shafts or time-of-day grade keep it from Palworld/Valheim finish.

Eu.bar_b_note: B's timber frame, diagonal brace, plank cap and stone footing read as a built half-timber wall, but the flat untextured tan infill, lone freestanding panel and the pale faceted boulder beside it still look like a prototype rather than a Palworld base piece.

top_changes.change: Relight the Kh stronghold courtyard: lift exposure and add a warm sun key with sky/fog fill so day reads as day, open the sightline to the sky, and add a tall lit keep tower or beacon as the landmark; replace flat banners with drawn-cloth war banners on poles.

Ship B's rounded leafy ironwood crown and recompose the grove: cluster saplings into groves and edges with varied scale, break the grass carpet with clearings and rock outcrops, and add distance haze plus a warm sun grade so foreground, midground and distance separate.

Finish the homestead wall and craft panel: give B's wall textured wattle/plaster infill and visible thickness, and give A's craft panel teal/cyan controller-glyph action prompts with higher contrast; also ground the Tanglevolt faint poses on B's model.
